name: Microgrid dispatch infeasibility alarm
summary: Reports that the requested allocation cannot satisfy the declared resource and operating constraints.
description: Reports that the requested allocation cannot satisfy the declared resource and operating constraints. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Target and resource constraints” at the input and “Dispatch infeasibility indication” at the output. The alarm must not imply a physically achievable target.
